# 🎴 Is the spanning tree generated by BFS unique for a given graph and source And the...

> [[00 - Flashcards MOC|🎴 Master MOC]] / [[00 - Trees & Heaps MOC|📁 Trees & Heaps MOC]]

---

### Q: Is the spanning tree generated by BFS unique for a given graph and source? And the calculated distances? #card

?
The BFS tree depends on the order in which incident edges are visited, while the distances do not. Specifically, given a fixed graph and source:

- **The BFS spanning tree (`prev[]`) produced** **is not unique**. It depends on the order in which the edges incident to each node are stored and examined in the adjacency lists. Different orders produce different trees (different parents in `prev[]`).
- **The distance array (`dist[]`) DOES NOT depend on the order,** it is an **invariant**. For any exploration order of adjacent nodes/vertices, BFS will always compute the same shortest distance (in number of edges) between the source $s$ and any node $u$.
